title.narrative: Southern Tigray Emergency Response and Rehabilitation Project

description.narrative: ltpgtThe recurrent conflicts in the northern part of Ethiopia left lots of humanitarian crisis. Hundreds of thousands of people in the contested areas lost their HH assets, displaced internally and settled in collective shelters in many locations. The people's food security and livelihoods were seriously affected and hence they remained dependents on the lifesaving humanitarian interventions. After two years of conflict, the two fighting parties had come to consensus to cease fire and sign agreements in Pretoria of South Africa in late 2022. Following the agreement, attempts were made to return the internally displaced persons but it has not been fully undertaken because of many unresolved factors. lt/pgtltpgtEven thought the signing of peace agreement is a progressing step forwarded to guarantee the people's security, the outcomes of the past conflicting years is negatively impacting in the lives of the returnees, and the host communities. According to the UN OCHA multi-sectorial inter agency assessment conducted in July/August 2024, the people are in needs of multidimensional immediate emergency responses to save their lives and relevant interventions to restore their food security and livelihoods. lt/pgtltpgtThis particular project therefore will target on 22,500 (4500HH) conflict affected communities in Raya-Alamata, Ofla, Korem Town, Alamata Town, Zata and Chercher districts to reach with the support of agricultural activities as a complementary response coordinated with other humanitarian actors operating in the locations. The objective of the project is to restore the food security and livelihoods of the the affected communities in the locations. According to the inter agency assessment report, these locations were identified that their livelihood mostly bases on agriculture. However, because of the recurrent conflict, the people in these locations were not able to engage in their agricultural activities with their full capacities but remained dependents on the limited humanitarian supports which were inconsistent because of the limited resources. Consequently, they have been food in-secured and their livelihoods have been seriously affected. ltspangtTherefore, to insure their food security and maintain their livelihoods, this project will focus on the early recovery activities to help the communities engage in their agricultural activities. The provision of agricultural inputs like seeds of main crops produced in the areas (teff, sorghum, vegetable), hand tools used for agricultural activities like sickles, digging hoes, shovels, wrecks and others will be in place. Moreover, the provision of pesticides, chemicals and soil fertilizer will be facilitated in collaboration with the line offices of the agricultural development of the local government. In addition, the professional and technical supports of agricultural extension will be given on crop production and post harvest management techniques. Small ruminants like goats and sheep are some of the main assets of the communities which were lost by the conflict. Thus, the project will be restocking them to the most affected households. Three she/female goats or ewe and two male (total five) will be provided to each household. Female headed households for this particular support will be in target. The restocking will be accompanied by livestock vaccinations and vet services. Cash for work was recommended by the assessment team but because of the dismantled structure of the local government in the locations, it will not be possible to mobilize the community and hence the activity has not been included in this plan. The project also will provide livestock health drugs and vet equipment to vet clinics in target kebeles based on the specific needs assessment which will be conducted in the project implementation period. lt/spangtltspangtThe project will set the targets selection criteria to reach the most affected groups.lt/spangtltspangt Moreover, rotection will be mainsreamed in all steps of the project implementation.lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgtltspangt lt/spangtltspangt lt/spangtlt/pgt
